# Returns and refunds (Brightwater Cycles, made-up sample data)

## Returns
Customers can return an unused bike within 30 days of delivery. The bike must have its original packaging
and no signs of riding. Accessories can be returned within 14 days.

## Refunds
Refunds go back to the original payment method within 5 business days of the bike arriving at the warehouse.
Return shipping is free for faulty items. For a change of mind, the customer pays 25 EUR for return shipping.
